IF ANY CERTIFICATEHOLDER IS IN ANY DOUBT AS TO THE ACTION IT SHOULD TAKE OR IS UNSURE OF THE IMPACT OF THE IMPLEMENTATION OF ANY EXTRAORDINARY RESOLUTION TO BE PROPOSED AT ANY ADJOURNED MEETING, IT SHOULD SEEK ITS OWN FINANCIAL, LEGAL, SHARI'A AND ACCOUNTING ADVICE, INCLUDING AS TO ANY TAX CONSEQUENCES, IMMEDIATELY FROM ITS STOCKBROKER, BANK MANAGER, SOLICITOR, ACCOUNTANT OR OTHER INDEPENDENT FINANCIAL, LEGAL OR SHARI'A ADVISER.
QIIB SENIOR ORYX LTD.
(Incorporated in the Cayman Islands as an exempted company with limited liability)
(LEI: 549300A07UNNRZ2DVQ26)

NOTICE OF ADJOURNED MEETINGS
to the holders of the following outstanding trust certificates of the Trustee (each a "Series" and together the "Certificates"):

U.S.$750,000,000 Trust Certificates due 2029 (the "Series 3 Certificates")1
U.S.$500,000,000 Trust Certificates due 2030 (the "Series 4 Certificates")

1    Comprised of (i) the outstanding U.S.$500,000,000 Trust Certificates due 2029 issued by the Trustee on 24 January 2024 ("Series 3 Tranche 1 Certificates"); (ii) the outstanding U.S.$250,000,000 Trust Certificates due 2029 issued by the Trustee on 31 July 2024 ("Series 3 Tranche 2 Certificates "), which are collectively represented by the Global Certificate with ISIN XS2747076664.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that separate meetings (each an "Initial Meeting" and together the "Initial Meetings") of the holders of each Series (the "Certificateholders") convened by the Trustee and held at the offices of Simmons & Simmons LLP at Citypoint, 1 Ropemaker Street, London EC2Y 9SS, United Kingdom on 14 October 2026 (the "Initial Meetings Date") were adjourned through the lack of quorum and that separate adjourned meetings (each an "Adjourned Meeting" and together the "Adjourned Meetings") will be held at the offices of Simmons & Simmons LLP at Citypoint, 1 Ropemaker Street, London EC2Y 9SS, United Kingdom on 28 October 2026 (the "Adjourned Meetings Date") for the purpose of considering and, if thought fit, passing the applicable resolutions set out below which will be proposed as an Extraordinary Resolution (as defined below) in accordance with the provisions of: (i) in respect of the Series 3 Certificates the amended and restated master trust deed dated 11 January 2024; and (ii) in respect of the Series 4 Certificates, the amended and restated master trust deed dated 18 September 2025, in each case as modified, supplemented and/or restated from time to time up to the date of issue of the relevant Series (each a "Master Trust Deed") and made between the Trustee, Qatar International Islamic Bank (Q.P.S.C.) (the "Bank") and HSBC Bank plc (the "Delegate").

The Adjourned Meeting in respect of the Series 3 Certificates will commence at 9:00 a.m. (London time) on the Adjourned Meetings Date, with the Adjourned Meeting in respect of the Series 4 Certificates being held at 9:15 a.m. (London time) or after the completion of the Adjourned Meeting in respect of the Series 3 Certificates (whichever is later).
No consent or participation fee will be payable in connection with any Consent Solicitation.

"Extraordinary Resolution" means a special quorum resolution (as defined in the relevant Master Trust Deed) to be granted by the Certificateholders of a Series by Electronic Consent or, if such Electronic Consent is not granted, to be put to Certificateholders at the Initial Meeting or Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series if the necessary quorum is present, as set out in the Notice of Adjourned Meetings.

Unless the context otherwise requires, capitalised terms used but not defined in this Notice shall have the meaning given in the relevant Master Trust Deed, the terms and conditions of the Certificates of the relevant Series (in respect of each Series, the "Conditions") or the relevant Extraordinary Resolution, as applicable.
BACKGROUND

The purpose of the Consent Solicitations is to invite Certificateholders of each Series to consider and, if thought fit, approve certain modifications to the relevant Series and related documents of the Certificates of such Series to provide for the proposed re-domiciliation of the Trustee from being an exempted company with limited liability incorporated in the Cayman Islands to being a special purpose company with limited liability incorporated in the QFC (the "Proposed Re-domiciliation"), as further described in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum.

None of the Trustee, the Bank, Standard Chartered Bank (the "Solicitation Agent"), the Agents, the Delegate or Sodali & Co Limited (the "Information and Tabulation Agent") is: (i) providing Certificateholders with any financial, legal, Shari'a, accounting or other advice in respect of any Consent Solicitation; (ii) expressing any opinion about the terms of any Consent Solicitation or any Extraordinary Resolution; or (iii) making any recommendation whether Certificateholders should participate in any Consent Solicitation or otherwise participate in the relevant Adjourned Meeting. Each Certificateholder must make their own decision as to whether to participate in any Consent Solicitation.

Each of the Agents and the Delegate has not been involved in the formulation of the Extraordinary Resolutions and each of the Agents and the Delegate expresses no opinion on the merits of any Extraordinary Resolution or on whether Certificateholders would be acting in their best interests in approving the relevant Extraordinary Resolution, and nothing in this Notice of Adjourned Meetings should be construed as a recommendation to Certificateholders from each of the Agents and the Delegate to vote in favour of, or against, the relevant Extraordinary Resolution. Certificateholders should take their own independent financial, legal, Shari'a, accounting or other advice on the merits and on the consequences of voting in favour of, or against, the relevant Extraordinary Resolution, including as to any tax consequences. Each of the Agents and the Delegate has not reviewed, nor will it be reviewing, any documents relating to any Consent Solicitation, except those to which it will be a party and this Notice of Adjourned Meetings. Neither the Agents, the Delegate nor any of their respective directors, officers, employees, agents or affiliates has verified, or assumes any responsibility for the accuracy or completeness of, any of the information concerning any Consent Solicitation, any Proposal, the Trustee, the Bank or the factual statements contained in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum or any other documents referred to in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum or assumes any responsibility for any failure by the Trustee or the Bank to disclose events that may have occurred and may affect the significance or accuracy of such information or the terms of any amendment (if any) to any Consent Solicitation.
General

Certificateholders may obtain a copy of the Consent Solicitation Memorandum from the Information and Tabulation Agent, the contact details for which are set out below. A Certificateholder will be required to produce evidence satisfactory to the Information and Tabulation Agent as to their status as a Certificateholder and that they are a person to whom it is lawful to send the Consent Solicitation Memorandum and to make an invitation to participate in any Consent Solicitation under applicable laws before being sent a copy of the Consent Solicitation Memorandum.

Copies of (i) the Master Trust Deed in respect of each Series; (ii) this Notice of Adjourned Meetings; and (iii) the current drafts of the Supplemental Trust Deeds as referred to in paragraph ‎4 of the relevant Extraordinary Resolution in respect of such Series, are also available for inspection by Certificateholders: (a) on and from the date of this Notice of Adjourned Meetings up to and including the Adjourned Meetings Date; and (b) for 15 minutes before any such Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series, in each case, at the specified offices of the Information and Tabulation Agent during normal business hours on any weekday (Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays excepted) and at the offices of Simmons & Simmons LLP at Citypoint, 1 Ropemaker Street, London EC2Y 9SS, United Kingdom. Any revised versions of the draft Supplemental Trust Deeds made available as described above and marked to indicate changes to such draft(s) made available on the date of this Notice of Adjourned Meetings will supersede the previous draft of such Supplemental Trust Deed and Certificateholders will be deemed to have notice of any such changes.

The attention of Certificateholders is particularly drawn to the procedures for voting, quorum and other requirements for the passing of an Extraordinary Resolution at an Adjourned Meeting in respect of a Series, which are set out in "Voting and Quorum" below. Having regard to such requirements, Certificateholders are strongly urged either to attend the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series or to take steps to be represented at such Adjourned Meeting (including by way of submitting Electronic Voting Instructions in respect of such Series in favour of a Proposal (all such terms as defined in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum)) as soon as possible.
Voting and Quorum
Adjourned Meetings

Certificateholders who have submitted and not revoked (in the limited circumstances in which revocation is permitted) a valid Electronic Voting Instruction in respect of the relevant Extraordinary Resolution, by which they will have given instructions for the appointment of one or more representatives of the Information and Tabulation Agent by the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent as their proxy to attend and vote (as specified in the relevant Electronic Voting Instruction) in respect of such Extraordinary Resolution at the Initial Meeting in respect of the relevant Series and the relevant Adjourned Meeting held following an adjournment of the relevant Initial Meeting, need take no further action to be represented at such Adjourned Meeting and the aggregate face amount of the Certificates of such Series that are the subject of such Electronic Voting Instructions will be counted for the purposes of establishing quorum and voting at the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series.

Certificateholders who have not submitted or have submitted and subsequently revoked (in the limited circumstances in which such revocation is permitted) an Electronic Voting Instruction in respect of the Extraordinary Resolution in respect of such Series should take note of the relevant provisions set out below detailing how such Certificateholders can attend or take steps to be represented at the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series.

1.         Subject as set out below, the provisions governing the convening and holding of a meeting of the Certificateholders are set out in Schedule 3 to the Master Trust Deed, a copy of which is available for inspection by the Certificateholders as referred to above.

Each person (a "beneficial owner") who is the owner of a particular aggregate face amount of the Certificates through Euroclear, Clearstream, Luxembourg or a person who is shown in the records of Euroclear SA/NV ("Euroclear") or Clearstream Banking S.A. ("Clearstream, Luxembourg") as a holder of the Certificates (a "Direct Participant"), should note that a beneficial owner will only be entitled to attend and vote at the relevant Adjourned Meeting in accordance with the procedures set out below and where a beneficial owner is not a Direct Participant it will need to make the necessary arrangements, either directly or with the intermediary through which it holds its Certificates, for the Direct Participant to complete these procedures on its behalf.

A Certificateholder who wishes to attend and vote at an Adjourned Meeting in respect of a Series in person must produce at such Adjourned Meeting a valid voting certificate issued by the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent.

A Certificateholder may obtain a voting certificate in respect of its Certificates from the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent by arranging for its Certificates of the relevant Series to be blocked in an account with Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg (unless the Certificate is the subject of a block voting instruction which has been issued and is outstanding in respect of the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series) not less than 48 hours before the time fixed for the Adjourned Meeting of such Series and within the relevant time limit specified by Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be, upon terms that the Certificates of such Series will not cease to be so blocked until the first to occur of the conclusion of the Adjourned Meeting of such Series and the surrender of the voting certificate to the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent and notification by the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent to Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be, of such surrender or the compliance in such other manner with the rules of Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be.

For the purposes of this Notice of Adjourned Meetings: (i) "48 hours" shall mean a period of 48 consecutive hours before any specified point in time. If the point in time falling 48 hours before that specified point in time falls outside the normal business hours of the Registrar's or the Principal Paying Agent's specified office (as applicable), the relevant deadline shall instead be the close of business at that specified office on the immediately preceding day on which banks are open for business in the place where that specified office is located;; and (ii) "24 hours" shall means a period of 24 consecutive hours before any specified point in time. If the point in time falling 24 hours before that specified point in time falls outside the normal business hours of the Registrar's or the Principal Paying Agent's specified office (as applicable), the relevant deadline shall instead be the close of business at that specified office on the immediately preceding day on which banks are open for business in the place where that specified office is located.

A Certificateholder not wishing to attend in person but wishing to vote at an Adjourned Meeting may either deliver the voting certificate(s) to the person whom it wishes to attend on its behalf or give a voting instruction in the form of an Electronic Voting Instruction in accordance with the standard procedures of Euroclear and/or Clearstream, Luxembourg and the provisions of the Master Trust Deed to, and require the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent to, include the votes attributable to its Certificates of the relevant Series in a block voting instruction issued by the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent for the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series, in which case the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent shall appoint a proxy to attend and vote at such Adjourned Meeting in accordance with such Certificateholder's instructions. Certificates of a Series subject to an Electronic Voting Instruction will be counted once for the purposes of determining the Electronic Consent Threshold in respect of such Series and once for the purposes of the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series. Certificates of a Series blocked pursuant to an Electronic Voting Instruction will remain blocked for both the Electronic Consent in respect of such Series and the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series without the need for further blocking instructions.

"Electronic Voting Instruction" means an electronic instruction submitted by a Direct Participant through Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg in accordance with their respective procedures which: (i) specifies the Direct Participant name, account number and aggregate face amount of Certificates to which such instruction relates; (ii) blocks such Certificates in the relevant Clearing System; (iii) provides voting instructions for the purposes of the Electronic Consent in respect of such Series, and the Initial Meeting and the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series; and (iv) constitutes instructions for such information to be made available to the Information and Tabulation Agent for tabulation and to the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent for the purposes of issuing any block voting instruction or appointing a proxy in accordance with the relevant Master Trust Deed.

If a Certificateholder wishes the votes attributable to its Certificates of a Series to be included in a block voting instruction for the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series, then (i) the Certificateholder must arrange for its Certificates to be blocked in an account with Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg for that purpose and (ii) the Certificateholder or a duly authorised person on its behalf submit an Electronic Voting Instruction in respect of such Series through the relevant Clearing System, which will be used by the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent, not less than 48 hours before the time fixed for the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series and within the time limit specified by Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be, upon terms that the Certificates will not cease to be so blocked until the first to occur of: (i) the conclusion of the Adjourned Meeting of such Series; and (ii) not less than 48 hours before the time for which the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series is convened, the notification in writing of any revocation of a Certificateholder's previous instructions to the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent and the same then being notified in writing by the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent to the Trustee and the Delegate at least 24 hours before the time appointed for holding the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series and such Certificates ceasing in accordance with the procedures of Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be, and with the agreement of the Registrar or the Principal Paying Agent (as applicable) to be held to its order or under its control, and that such instruction is, during the period commencing 48 hours prior to the time for which the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series is convened and within the time limit specified by Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be, and ending at the conclusion or adjournment thereof, neither revocable nor capable of amendment.

For the above purposes, instructions given by Direct Participants to the Information and Tabulation Agent through Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg will be deemed to be instructions given to the Registrar and the Principal Paying Agent.

2.         At the Adjourned Meeting in respect of a Series, one or more persons holding or representing 25 per cent. of the then aggregate outstanding face amount of the Certificates of such Series shall form a quorum and shall have the power to pass such Extraordinary Resolution. If a quorum is not present within 15 minutes from the time initially fixed for the relevant Adjourned Meeting, such Adjourned Meeting will be dissolved.

Voting certificates obtained and Electronic Voting Instructions given in respect of the relevant Initial Meeting (unless revoked in accordance with the terms of the relevant Master Trust Deed and, in the case of Electronic Voting Instructions in respect of such Series, in accordance with the procedures of the Euroclear or Clearstream, Luxembourg, as the case may be) shall remain valid for such Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series.

Certificateholders should note these quorum requirements and should be aware that, if the Certificateholders either present or appropriately represented at the relevant Adjourned Meeting are insufficient to form a quorum for the relevant Extraordinary Resolution in respect of such Series, such Extraordinary Resolution cannot be formally considered at such Adjourned Meeting. Certificateholders are therefore encouraged either to attend the relevant Adjourned Meeting in person or to arrange to be represented at the relevant Adjourned Meeting as soon as possible.

3.         Every question submitted to the relevant Adjourned Meeting shall be decided in the first instance by a show of hands and in case of equality of votes the chairperson of such Adjourned Meeting shall both on a show of hands and on a poll have a casting vote in addition to the vote or votes (if any) to which he may be entitled as a holder of a voting certificate or as a proxy or as a representative.

Unless a poll is (before, or on the declaration of the result of, the show of hands) demanded by the chairperson of the relevant Adjourned Meeting, the Trustee, the Bank, the Delegate or any person present holding or representing in the aggregate not less than one fiftieth of the aggregate face amount of the Certificates of such Series then outstanding, a declaration by the chairperson of such Adjourned Meeting that a resolution has been carried or carried by a particular majority or lost or not carried by a particular majority shall be conclusive evidence of the fact without proof of the number or proportion of the votes recorded in favour or against such resolution.

On a show of hands every person who is present in person and produces a voting certificate or is a proxy or representative shall have one vote. On a poll every such person shall have one vote in respect of each U.S.$1,000 in aggregate face amount of the Certificates of such Series represented by the voting certificate so produced or in respect of which they are a holder, proxy or representative.

4.         To be passed at the relevant Adjourned Meeting, the relevant Extraordinary Resolution requires a majority in favour of not less than three-quarters of the persons voting thereat upon a show of hands or, if a poll is duly demanded, by a majority in favour consisting of not less than three-quarters of the votes cast in respect of the relevant Extraordinary Resolution. If passed, the relevant Extraordinary Resolution shall be binding on all Certificateholders of such Series, whether or not present at the Adjourned Meeting in respect of such Series at which it is passed and whether or not voting.

EXTRAORDINARY RESOLUTIONS
PART A
EXTRAORDINARY RESOLUTION IN RESPECT OF THE SERIES 3 CERTIFICATES (XS2747076664)

"THAT this meeting of the holders of the outstanding U.S.$750,000,000 Trust Certificates due 2029 (XS2747076664) (the "Certificates") of QIIB Senior Oryx Ltd. 1.         authorises, sanctions, assents to and approves the Proposal (as defined herein) and its implementation by way of the modification of: (i) the terms and conditions of the Certificates (the "Conditions"), substantially in the form set out in the Schedule to the Notice of Circulating Extraordinary Resolutions by Electronic Consent and of Meetings; (ii) the Master Trust Deed by way of the Supplemental Trust Deed (as defined below), substantially in the form set out in the Schedule to the Notice of Circulating Extraordinary Resolutions by Electronic Consent and of Meetings; (iii) any related ancillary documents in respect of the Certificates; and (iv) the constitutional documents of the Trustee, in each case to the extent necessary, desirable or otherwise appropriate to reflect, facilitate or give effect to the re-domiciliation of the Trustee from the Cayman Islands to the Qatar Financial Centre, including any revised, alternative or additional steps by which substantially the same commercial and legal outcome is achieved;

2.         agrees to release and waive all rights, claims, actions or entitlements against the Trustee and the Bank, whether under the Conditions and any other agreement, deed, undertaking or other document relating to the Certificates, in each case, arising in connection with the Consent Solicitation and/or the Proposal;

3.         sanctions every abrogation, modification or compromise of, or arrangement in respect of, the rights of the Certificateholders appertaining to the Certificates against the Trustee or the Bank, whether or not such rights arise under the Conditions or otherwise, involved in or resulting from or to be effected by, the modifications referred to in paragraph ‎1 of this Extraordinary Resolution and their implementation;
4.         authorises, directs, requests, sanctions and empowers the Delegate and the Trustee to:

(a)           concur in the modifications referred to in paragraph ‎1 of this Extraordinary Resolution and, in order to give effect to and implement such modifications, on or shortly after the passing of this Extraordinary Resolution and the satisfaction of the condition in paragraph ‎7 below, to execute a supplemental trust deed (the "Supplemental Trust Deed") substantially in the form of the draft produced to this meeting and signed by the chairperson of the meeting for the purpose of identification, with such amendments (if any) as may be requested by the Trustee and the Bank and approved by the Delegate, in its sole and absolute discretion, or required by the Delegate in accordance with the provisions of the Master Trust Deed; and

(b)          concur in, and execute and do all such other deeds, agreements, instruments, acts and things as may be necessary, desirable or expedient, in the sole and absolute discretion of the Delegate, to carry out and give effect to this Extraordinary Resolution and the implementation of the modifications referred to in paragraph ‎1 of this Extraordinary Resolution (the "Amendment Documents");

5.         authorises, sanctions, assents to and approves the implementation of such trust, foundation, nominee or other ownership arrangements in respect of the shares in the Trustee as the Trustee and the Bank may consider necessary or desirable to preserve the Trustee's status as an orphan special purpose vehicle in connection with the re-domiciliation of the Trustee to the Qatar Financial Centre, including the establishment of a trust in the Qatar Financial Centre and any transfer of the shares in the Trustee from the existing Cayman Islands charitable trust;

6.         declares, concurs and acknowledges that a vote in favour of the Extraordinary Resolution by the Electronic Consent Deadline automatically constitutes an Electronic Consent as set out in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum;

7.         declares that (a) this Extraordinary Resolution shall take effect upon being duly passed by Electronic Consent or at the relevant Meeting, as applicable; (b) the implementation of the modifications contemplated by this Extraordinary Resolution shall be subject to satisfaction of the Implementation Conditions; and (c) any delay in satisfying the Implementation Conditions shall not affect the validity or continuing effectiveness of this Extraordinary Resolution;

8.         discharges, indemnifies, holds harmless and exonerates the Agents and the Delegate from any and all liability for which it may have become or may become responsible under the Master Trust Deed or the Certificates or any other document in respect of any act or omission in connection with this Extraordinary Resolution or its implementation or the implementation of the Proposal, the modifications referred to in this Extraordinary Resolution or the implementation of those modifications or the executing of any deeds, agreements, documents or instructions, the performance of any acts, matters or things to be done to carry out and give effect to the matters contemplated in the Amendment Documents, the Notice of Circulating Extraordinary Resolutions by Electronic Consent and of Meetings, this Extraordinary Resolution or the Proposal;

9.         irrevocably waives any claim that the Certificateholders may have against the Agents and the Delegate arising as a result of any loss or damage which the Certificateholders may suffer or incur as a result of the Agents and the Delegate acting upon this Extraordinary Resolution (including but not limited to circumstances where it is subsequently found that this Extraordinary Resolution is not valid or binding on the holders) and the Certificateholders further confirm that the Certificateholders will not seek to hold the Agents and the Delegate liable for any such loss or damage;

10.       approves that each of the Agents and the Delegate be and is hereby authorised and instructed not to obtain any legal opinions in relation to, or to enquire into the power and capacity of any person to enter into the Amendment Documents or any other document necessary, desirable or expedient in connection with the modifications referred to paragraph 1 of this Extraordinary Resolution or the due execution and delivery thereof by any party thereto or the validity and enforceability thereof; and
11.       acknowledges that the following terms, as used in this Extraordinary Resolution shall have the meaning given below:
"Agents" has the meaning given to it in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum.
"Consent Solicitation" means the invitation by the Trustee to holders of the Certificates to approve this Extraordinary Resolution, as more fully described in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum.
"Consent Solicitation Memorandum" means the consent solicitation memorandum dated 22 September 2026 prepared by the Trustee in relation to the Consent Solicitations.

"Electronic Consent Deadline" means 4:00 p.m. (London time) on 5 October 2026 (subject to the right of the Trustee to extend, re-open, withdraw and/or terminate the Consent Solicitation, as applicable).

"Extraordinary Resolution" means a special quorum resolution (as defined in the Master Trust Deed) to be granted by the Certificateholders by Electronic Consent or, if such Electronic Consent is not granted, to be put to Certificateholders at the Meeting if the necessary quorum is present, as set out in the Notice of Circulating Extraordinary Resolutions by Electronic Consent and of Meetings.
"Implementation Conditions" has the meaning given to it in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum.
"Proposal" has the meaning given to it in the Consent Solicitation Memorandum."
